name: finance_day_rotate
note: copies today's finance stats DS:71d1 (21 longs) to yesterday DS:7472, clears today, sets stats[0] = current money of player 8b88 (8bbc+8)

name: stats_day_rotate
note: per player: 1c78->1c6a (14 B); 74ca->789e, 7690->791e (0x80 B), 5533->5553; shifts 7-day viewer history 6d89 and stores 7-day average (long, sum/7) at 6da5; clears 74ca/7690

name: studio_slot_release
note: record DS:6145+slot*16: if id (+0) set: clears it, sets +5=0,+4=1 and removes all productions of owner (+3) with that id (production_remove)

name: stations_settle
note: transmitter stations DS:1ce9+p*0x1ce (32 x 14 B; long price +0, status +0xc): status 1 (bought today) -> subtract price from money, money_add(3, price); status 2 (sold) -> zero values; clears status, then stations_reach_update(player)

name: production_clear_first
note: memset 15 B of first production entry DS:732c+p*0x4b; no callers

name: case_remove
note: removes idx from programme list DS:2463 (count 732a) = player's suitcase of bought programmes

name: production_costs_update
note: for each production of player: compares cast bytes with show data (far 713c); for human player pays changed cast fees money_add(7, fee from actor table 4ff3 / 6215); if 74c6[p] > 100 subtract 100 and money_add(6, table 722c)

name: case_store_to_archive
note: moves programmes from suitcase list 2463 into current player's archive 6ef9 (by genre, series genre 0xb, max 4 per genre); films 0x1d / 0xbb trigger events 2bd1_24a5 / 2bd1_24d9
